name: Face Illumination
algorithm: Face Illumination — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial illumination consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **光Source推定**: The primary illumination direction is estimated from facial shading using shape-from-shading techniques. The face's known approximate 3D geometry (frontal face as a convex surface) constrains the lighting estimation — shadow patterns on nose, cheeks, and forehead indicate light position.

2. **顔-Scene照明比較**: The illumination direction estimated from facial shading is compared with illumination cues in the scene: background shadows, specular highlights on objects, window/light positions. In authentic video, face and scene illumination match. Deepfake face insertion may produce faces lit from a different direction than the scene.

3. **影一貫性検証**: Facial shadows (nose shadow, orbital shadows, chin shadow) are analyzed for mutual consistency — all shadows on the face should originate from the same light source(s). AI-generated faces may produce physically inconsistent shadow patterns where different facial features appear lit from different directions.

4. **時間的照明安定性**: As the head rotates, facial shading should change smoothly and consistently with the estimated light source position. The method tracks illumination parameters across frames. Deepfakes may produce illumination that doesn't respond correctly to head pose changes — illumination remaining static during head rotation or changing independently of physical light positions.

5. **Specular-Diffuse分解**: Facial skin shows both diffuse reflection (matte appearance) and specular reflection (highlights on forehead, nose, cheeks). The ratio and spatial distribution of specular-to-diffuse components should follow physical models. AI generators may produce unnatural specular patterns, absent highlights, or incorrect specular-to-diffuse ratios.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through face illumination analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
